nuggets.text: The Huskers host Bowling Green in an NCAA-record 412th consecutive sellout at Memorial Stadium.
Nebraska's sellout streak began against Missouri in 1962, with John F. Kennedy in the White House.
Jamal Rule is the first true freshman Husker running back to top 100 yards in a season opener in 22 seasons.
Anthony Colandrea was UNLV's first quarterback since Randall Cunningham to win conference player of the year honors.
Anthony Colandrea accounted for four touchdowns with zero turnovers in his Husker debut against Ohio.
The Huskers' opening win over Ohio was the 100th season-opening victory in program history.
Memorial Stadium drew 92,003 fans for a 2023 volleyball match, a record crowd for a women's sporting event.
Matt Rhule walked on as a linebacker at Penn State under Joe Paterno.
Nebraska's Tunnel Walk entrance is set to Sirius, an instrumental piece.
Matt Rhule was an assistant offensive line coach for the New York Giants in 2012.
